subject: mariner
brief: A weathered mariner in his mid-50s with clear blue eyes, a full grey beard with the same beard shape in every shot, deep weather-lined facial wrinkles, a stocky working build, a dark charcoal knit watch cap, a heavy slate-grey waterproof jacket over a ribbed grey sweater, rough salt-worn hands, and a stoic coastal presence. He must remain the same man in every image. Do not replace him with a woman, a younger man, a bald man, a clean-shaven man, or a background extra.
suffix: The same mariner is the primary subject. Background people must remain background. No readable text, no signage, no labels, no captions. 16mm-grain coastal realism.
